about_the_game:
Salt Player for Windows


Salt Player for Windows (SPW) is a brand new production version of Salt Player on the Windows platform, bringing excellent and unique audio playback and management functions to Windows users!

Software Experience


New Development: This game is not a simple porting of Salt Player Android, but a nearly new development that brings more features and is more user-friendly from scratch!
New Design: The newly designed SaltUI Pro, combined with the Windows platform design, brings a design language that is more suitable for Windows users. At the same time, there has been a new breakthrough in software interaction. After seeing the twin brother like playback interface design in recent years, I have taken on a new look.
More Special and Professional: This work not only has strong capabilities in audio technology, but also has newly created enhanced audio management functions, which is more special and professional.

Audio Playback


Multi Engine Mode: Optional DirectSound or WASAPI (exclusive), providing excellent audio playback experience.
High Quality Sampling: Up to 256 inc sampling quality can be selected to avoid low-quality SRC.
Multi Format Support: Supports multiple audio formats such as WAVE/MULAW/ADPCM/MP1/MP2/MP3/OGG/AAC/APE.
Gapless Playback: When a certain audio is about to be played, quickly load the next audio and play the audio without any gaps, which is more suitable for listening to specific gapless music albums.

Audio Management


Built in Genre: Built in hundreds of genre classifications, intelligently categorizing styles for you, with features such as hierarchical genre classification and genre introduction.
More Professional Classification: More professional in categories such as albums and artists, feeling as if collecting physical albums.
Built in Tag Editing: More convenient for editing various audio tags.
No Automatic Deletion Management: The music library adopts the latest automatic addition only management, and regardless of storage, uninstallation, file movement, or deletion, the music library data will not be automatically discarded, making it more convenient to recover or migrate them.
